attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story.
Create ONE SIMPLE GRAYSCALE LINE-ART storyboard drawing, target 1920 x 1080 landscape (16:9), for a Chinese narrative visual novel. This is the next quiet moment AFTER the needle has been put away, using image 1 as the existing scene to adapt. Only a sketch, no finished coloring or dense rendering.

INPUT ROLES, in order:
1 Existing creek scene: preserve this geographical setting and the same broad relative arrangement: Pei Qian left-front, Chen Ping'an center-front by water, Zhu Lian right-back on a slightly higher rock, the bamboo bookbox far right on dry bank. This is the PREVIOUS action, NOT the new pose. Remove the needle and Pei's foot-held-up-for-treatment posture. Do not copy its excessive tiny textures or Zhu's ornate extra straps.
2 Chen's face identity master: the same narrow tapering face, natural narrow eyes, mature young adult 20–22, same hairline and tied bun, calm dependable temperament. Do not beautify or make adolescent.
3 Chen's warm-weather clothing structure: same short-sleeved outer robe, long inner sleeves, wrist wraps, rope belt and trousers; bookbox is OFF HIS BACK in this scene. Pants rolled up and bare lower legs continue image 1. NO shoulder straps, NO old waist pouch.
4 Pei's exact child identity and clothing: small short lower face, alert almond eyes, practical twin buns, small lean sturdy child build, wrapped sleeves, rough layered short tunic, rope waist and soft pouch on HER OWN LEFT waist. Preserve her cloth volumes and worn irregular layers. Her master has cloth shoes but THIS SCRIPT explicitly has STRAW SANDALS, and she has taken them off; bare feet as in image 1, no newly added socks or full leg wraps.
5 Zhu's old-face master: same 55–65 old servant face, narrow eyes, cheek/jaw structure, tied black-gray hair and short thin moustache/goatee. Use the facial structure and a FEW age creases, NOT photographic pores or dense wrinkles.
6 Zhu's body/clothing master: plain knee-length cross-collar robe, cloth sash, loose trousers, cloth shoes, lean slightly stooped shoulders. No added weapons, fan, drinking vessel, ornate backpack or excessive cords. Do not turn him into a young handsome man or frail white-bearded sage.
7 Chen's UPDATED jade hairpin: slender shaft, asymmetrical open scroll head on HIS OWN RIGHT side, natural foreshortening through bun. Replaces the old plain round knob visible in refs 1–3. The multicolor hair regions are DIAGRAM LABELS, not actual hair colors or shapes to copy. Black hair rendered with sparse light graphite groups.
8 Bamboo bookbox construction only: rectangular OPEN-TOP woven walls, four corner posts, rope joints, side-hung straw hat and spare sandals. Do not add the screenshot person, red dress, phone UI, labels, or 3D rendering.
9 Single gourd construction only: one small gourd hanging by a SHORT cord from Chen's belt, simple indication of curled ornament. No extra bag, second gourd, giant bottle, or long dangling gourd cord.

NEW NARRATIVE MOMENT:
The three travelers have stopped at the same quiet mountain creek on their way home. Pei has PUT THE NEEDLE COMPLETELY AWAY. She now holds one straw sandal gently across her lap with both hands and has lifted her face slightly toward Chen to chat; a small knowing smile, not exaggerated acting. The other sandal rests separately on a dry rock beside her. Her formerly raised treatment leg is now lowered, treated foot resting naturally on a dry stone; the other foot can remain at the shallow water edge. No wound, blood, treatment gesture or needle at all.
Chen is still comfortably seated on the same bank with BOTH bare feet in shallow flowing water; knees anatomically separate, rolled trousers, relaxed torso turned slightly toward Pei. One hand rests on a knee, the other supports lightly on the rock beside his hip. His head turns toward Pei with a restrained gentle smile, not looking at the viewer. His own pair of removed sandals remains on the dry rock near his right-front side, distinct from Pei's pair and the spare shoes on the box. Keep the bookbox on the far-right bank, not on anybody's back. One gourd visibly connects to his waist.
Zhu sits naturally on the higher rock behind/right, shoes grounded on the lower dry ledge, shoulders slightly forward, hands resting loosely on his knees. He looks toward Pei with a faint wry closed-mouth smile, ready to join the banter. Stable body support, not a floating squat. Exactly THREE people.

COMPOSITION:
Gently pull the camera back from ref 1 and simplify the shot, retaining the left stream / right dry bank axis and recognizable distant mountain silhouettes. Relaxed triangular grouping, natural varied seated heights and depth. Preserve Pei's established child proportions relative to the two adults, accounting for the higher stone under Zhu; do not shrink her into a toddler to create space. Faces and Pei's hands/sandal are legible above the lower dialogue area. Keep the feet and the seating contacts visible within the frame, with breathing room around heads and foreground low-detail water/rocks. No furniture, corridor, rain, palace, extra characters, speech balloons or text.

DRAWING STYLE:
Restrained fine charcoal-gray LINE ART on near-white paper, simple clear silhouettes, only a few light gray shadow planes to show body weight and contact. No color. Use very few internal fold lines; hair in simple grouped outlines, not solid black masses. Distant mountains, trees, stream and rocks are lightly suggested and much quieter than the people. NO dense hatching, repetitive rock texture, tiny leaf patterns, woven noise, graphite smudges, heavy gray wash, black vignette, photographic finish, manga chibi faces, or glossy 3D look. This is a clean readable working sketch for composition and identity review, not a finished grayscale painting.
